subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Which existing opt-in should authorize xAI image-generation requests to private destinations: the global browser SSRF policy, the xAI provider request setting, or a narrower configured-origin policy?
rationale: All choices intentionally expand a network security boundary, and current code provides both broad opt-ins and narrower origin-scoped patterns; repository evidence cannot establish the intended xAI product policy without owner intent.

options.title: Use canonical shared policy
options.body: Honor the browser opt-in through the resolver and the xAI request setting through `useConfiguredRequest`, preserving shared precedence and default deny.

options.title: Require provider-scoped opt-in
options.body: Honor only `models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork` so browser navigation policy does not authorize provider traffic.

options.title: Require narrower origin trust
options.body: Replace broad private-network authority with trust scoped to the configured xAI base URL and guarded redirects.

recommendation.title: Use canonical shared policy
recommendation.body: Honor the browser opt-in through the resolver and the xAI request setting through `useConfiguredRequest`, preserving shared precedence and default deny.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent adjacent merged work established provider image-generation SSRF scope and redirect boundaries.
